summary.zh: 赞噢校园集市，内置离线 Token 捕捉器
summary.en: Zanao campus marketplace with a bundled offline token catcher

description.zh: 内置「集市 Token 捕捉器」，只在本机离线处理登录凭证，不上传数据。导入账号后可浏览帖子、搜索、评论、点赞、消息、个人资料与发帖，并附带 zanao CLI 技能。
description.en: Bundles the offline Zanao token catcher; credentials stay on-device and nothing is uploaded. Import an account to browse threads, search, comment, like, read messages and profile, and post. Includes the zanao CLI skill.
